HERCEPTIN (trastuzumab) — HER2-targeted Monoclonal Antibody
MECHANISM: Binds HER2 extracellular domain (domain IV). Inhibits HER2-mediated signaling, ADCC activation, and prevents HER2 cleavage. HER2 overexpression drives aggressive tumor growth.
KEY INDICATIONS: - Early breast cancer: Adjuvant post-surgery (HER2+ stage I-III) — 1 year treatment - Metastatic breast cancer: 1st line with taxane ± pertuzumab (CLEOPATRA), 2nd line monotherapy - HER2+ gastric/gastroesophageal junction: 1st line with capecitabine + cisplatin (ToGA trial)
DOSING: Loading 8 mg/kg IV → maintenance 6 mg/kg Q3W; OR 4 mg/kg → 2 mg/kg QW. SC formulation (600 mg fixed SC Q3W) available — patient convenience.
KEY TRIAL DATA: - HERA: 50% reduction in recurrence in adjuvant EBC at 1 year - CLEOPATRA: OS 57.1 months (Herceptin + pertuzumab + docetaxel) — landmark HER2+ MBC - ToGA: 13.8 vs 11.1 months OS in HER2+ gastric cancer
BIOMARKER: HER2 IHC 3+ or FISH amplified. IHC 2+ needs FISH confirmation. Testing mandatory.
CARDIAC MONITORING: LVEF baseline and Q3 months. Hold if LVEF drops >10 points OR below 50%. Cardiotoxicity is additive with anthracyclines.
BIOSIMILARS IN INDIA: Several trastuzumab biosimilars available (Hertraz, Biceltis, Canmab). Herceptin remains originator reference.

HERCEPTIN (trastuzumab) — Rep ke liye
KYA HAI: HER2-targeted therapy — jab tumor cells pe HER2 protein zyada hota hai, Herceptin usse block karta hai. Breast cancer aur stomach cancer dono mein use hota hai.
KAHAN USE HOTA HAI: - Breast cancer surgery ke baad: HER2+ patients mein 1 saal treatment — cancer wapas aane se rokta hai - Metastatic breast cancer: Taxane ke saath first line mein - HER2+ stomach cancer: Chemo ke saath first line
DOSE: IV infusion — pehli baar 8 mg/kg phir har 3 hafte 6 mg/kg. SC injection bhi available hai (600 mg) — patient ke liye easy.
DOCTOR SE KAISE BAAT KAREIN: - "Dr. saab, HER2 testing ho rahi hai aapke breast cancer patients mein? HERA data mein 50% recurrence kam hua 1 saal Herceptin se." - "CLEOPATRA: Pertuzumab ke saath OS 57 months — bahut strong data." - "ToGA trial — HER2+ gastric cancer mein bhi approve hai, kya aap gastric patients mein HER2 test karte hain?"
IMPORTANT — Dil ki care: Herceptin se heart function affect ho sakti hai, especially agar pehle anthracyclines liye hain. LVEF monitor karna zaroori hai.
BIOSIMILARS: India mein kai biosimilars hain (Hertraz etc.). Originator vs biosimilar discussion mein ready rehna — quality aur data gap ke baare mein baat karein.
